answer: Go to the "My Profile" tab in your sidebar. Fill in your details (name, branch, education, target role) and click Save — your profile updates immediately.
Open the "My Skills" tab. You can add technical and soft skills there and set a proficiency level for each. These skills are used to match you with opportunities.
Open the "Industry Opportunities" tab to browse and filter all internships and jobs, or just ask me what you're looking for and I'll search for you right here.
Open any opportunity's details from the "Industry Opportunities" tab and click the "Apply" button. You can track the status of every application in "My Applications".
Certifications can be added from the "My Profile" or "Portfolio" tab — look for the certifications section and add the title and issuing organization there.
Your latest skill assessment results are shown in the "Skill Assessment" tab, and they also feed into your "Skill Gap Analysis".
The "Skill Gap Analysis" tab compares your current skills against a target job role and shows exactly which skills you're missing, so you know what to learn next.
Click "Save Opportunity" on any listing to bookmark it. You can review everything you've saved in the "Saved Opportunities" tab.
The "Learning & Skill Development" tab (and "Recommended For You") lists courses and resources tailored to the skills you're missing.
If you're signed in as an Industry user, use the "Post New Opportunity" tab to publish a new internship, job, or project listing.
Industry accounts can use "Candidate Search" or "Talent Discovery" to find students whose skills match a role you're hiring for.
Go to the API status / settings area and use "Connect LinkedIn" to link your account — this is optional and only used to enrich live industry data.
Click the "Logout" button at the bottom of the sidebar.
